budget.scope: complete trusted protocol ledger at read time; not project/global/hostile completeness

streamed.scope: Explicit workspace excludes caller-owned source storage and whole-process overhead
streamed.work_scope: shared direct coefficients, radius conversion, ball rows, and worst-case interval fallback

admission.selection_policy: token when 4*tokens <= width; otherwise streamed; admitted candidates only

admission.policy: minimum admitted normal-path work proxy; fallback remains reserved; no timing guarantee

coefficient_verification.guarantee: squared Euclidean error bounds for exact suffix coefficients

solver_diagnostics.runtime_premise: IEEE binary64 RN elementary operations; gradual underflow

worker.budget_scope: CPU admission allowance; trusted comparison worker; controller CPU excluded
worker.controller_completion_means: the outcome is sealed; inspect outcome.status for worker success
worker.limit_scope: address space and CPU per process; wall limit and cleanup for ordinary process-group descendants
worker.memory_scope: RLIMIT_AS limits virtual address space, not physical RSS
worker.thread_scope: library thread environment requests; CPU affinity also applies

timing_boundary.excluded_tail: CPU settlement, log summaries, acknowledgment validation, receipt commit and store close
